name: Complete Salad
body:
Station and Complexity garde manger 4

Flavor Profiles temperature, bitter, texture, umami
Additional Ingredients sour, spicy, or sweet

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 4

DESCRIPTION

A complete salad is an even balance of vegetables, starches (bread, grains, or potatoes), and meats that improves eye strength and awareness.

When consumed, it grants darkvision out to 30 feet for the duration.

Additional sour ingredients also grant low-light vision for the duration.

Additional spicy ingredients also grant scent out to 30 feet for the duration.

Additional sweet ingredients increase the range of darkvision by +30 feet.
